CONTROL FRAMEWORK

Evidence-first validation

The AI layer classifies collected documents; it does not invent the regulatory event.

Human-in-the-loop
01

Approved source

The collector runs only against registered official authority endpoints.

02

Change detection

URLs and publication dates are compared with the previous saved run.

03

Evidence validation

AI evidence must be an exact excerpt from the fetched source or the result is held back.

04

Human decision

Every item remains review-required until a person confirms scope and impact.

✓

Anti-hallucination control

No fallback regulation is displayed when the live data file is unavailable. The workspace shows an explicit error or empty state instead.
